title: Ranked
html:
Ranked matchmaking pits players against each other in rated games that feed a competitive leaderboard ladder. Ranked 1v1 has been available for some time; Update 33.0 added ranked 2v2 alongside it, with its own ladder.

Ranked 2v2

  • 2v2 has its own leaderboard ladder, shown as a separate leaderboard tab.
  • Matchmaking prefers to pair clanmates as teammates.
  • PvP spawn immunity lasts 1 minute.
  • Games use compact maps only 50% of the time.
  • A game ends early when a full team is dead or disconnected.

Matchmaking

  • The live queue size is shown while you wait, and the client reconnects on silent disconnects.
  • Matches that do not fill, or that start short-handed or fail to fully spawn, are cancelled.

Leaderboards

The 1v1 ranked leaderboard is an individual ladder and no longer shows clan tags in the rank column; the clan tag is a separate, filterable column.
